Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported
in Sugar Land, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give my details as needed. Let's go with the accident.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were driving and what you were doing when the collision happened?
A: I was driving through a major intersection and needed to turn left. I had my signal on and was waiting for a gap in
oncoming traffic. The light had turned yellow, so I went when I thought it was clear.
Q: When you began your turn, what did you see in the oncoming lanes?
A: There was a vehicle coming toward me, but it looked farther away than it actually was. I thought I had time. Then it
hit the front driver side of my car.
Q: Did you notice the other vehicle's headlights or signal before you started moving?
A: Not that I remember. It was a busy afternoon and there was a lot of glare off the pavement.
Q: After the impact, what happened to you physically?
A: My left wrist hit the stereing wheel and the door frame. I felt immediate pain and couldn't grip anything. An
ambulance took me to the hospital, where they confirmed a fracture in my wrist. I've been wearing a splint since and I
have a follow-up appointment with a hand specialist next week.
Q: Thank you. Were there any passengers in your vehicle or any witnesses you are aware of?
A: No passengers. A man in a parked car across the road came over to check on me, but I didn't get his information.
Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was trying to be careful. I just want my car repaired and my medical bills taken care of.
Q: Thank you. That concludes this statement.
</page>
